context: You find Barton, a twitchy, frustrated bandit, rifling around the altar of an abandoned chapel for a mechanism or clue that will open a passage into the crypt just outside in the corridor. The chapel is eerie and neglected — its patron god is unknown and there are disturbing signs like a long-rotted banquet that make the place unnerving. Barton mutters to himself about past failures (he once triggered skeletons when trying this) and is desperate not to go home empty-handed. Other bandits are nearby outside and are alarmed or anxious about whatever happens inside.
